assumptions: Hosted snapshot with record-time filtering; historical relationship changes, deletions and merges remain unresolved.
The fixed 8192-query parent validation cohort is not the full-validation workload.
Preparation, download, graph construction, validation replay and correctness checks are excluded from online timings.
The warmup count is recorded; raw online timings and synchronized stage replay timings are separate.
CUDA correctness and performance require an NVIDIA GPU; CPU checks do not establish them.
Removing the avoidable fingerprint cycle does not establish that all long collections disappear.
All natural pauses remain in the estimator; no GC subtraction, filtering or forced between-pass collection is used.
GC durations overlap online and collection wall times; they are not additional costs to add again.
A new independent session is needed before describing any V2 efficiency result as reproduced.
gc_observer: minimal collection callbacks and exact executor timer windows; observer overhead present
cleanup_accounting: retain all natural GC inside online timings; report GC durations separately without subtraction or double counting
collection_wall_scope: experiment collection loop including warmups, online passes, audits, stage replays and reporting; not a serving throughput denominator
comparison_to_historical_results: new protocol; historical percentages remain unchanged and separate
fingerprint_scope: cycle-free occurrence hashing during complete saved-validation replay and measured paired cases
